value_stream.name: Packaging, Pallet & Returnable Transport Item (RTI) Management

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Sustainability (links to VS-25/VS-73), Store Ops (links to VS-07), DC (links to VS-04), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Waste Mgmt (links to VS-73)
fields.Trigger: Sustainability plan (links to VS-25); waste analytics (links to VS-73)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze packaging-waste generation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track waste-reduction outcomes" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: baseline and analytics; operational: program governance (W3544)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Waste-opacity risk**: Packaging waste unmeasured; mitigated by baseline and analytics
- **Initiative-fragmentation risk**: Reduction efforts uncoordinated; mitigated by program governance (W3544)
System Touchpoints: - Waste (links to VS-73); ESG (links to VS-25.3); packaging data (links to VS-29/VS-28.1); circular economy (links to VS-73.3); PMO (links to VS-112)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Sustainability analyze packaging-waste generation: corrugate, plastic, stretch-wrap, dunnage, and pallet waste by location/category, and identify reduction opportunities (right-sizing W3522, reusable RTI W3529, elimination, material substitution); baseline vs the waste program (links to VS-73)

Packaging Eng execute waste-reduction initiatives: packaging redesign/elimination, reusable vs single-use transitions, baling/recycling of corrugate/plastic at DC/store (links to VS-73), and supplier take-back; manage via the PMO (links to VS-112) where cross-functional

Sustainability/Packaging Eng track waste-reduction outcomes (tons reduced, recycling rate, disposal cost avoided), report to the ESG program (links to VS-25.3) and governance (W3544), and feed the circular-economy analytics (links to VS-73.3) and EPR reporting (W3539)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-41), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Quality (links to VS-31), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Supplier, Marketing (links to VS-14)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-post of "Packaging Eng/Merchandising build the material-transition roadmap" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate substitute packaging" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track transition progress" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: testing and phased rollout; operational: business case and scale negotiation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Performance-degradation risk**: Sustainable materials under-perform (shelf-life, protection); mitigated by testing and phased rollout
- **Cost-premium risk**: Sustainable materials raise cost; mitigated by business case and scale negotiation
System Touchpoints: - Packaging spec/BOM (links to VS-29/W3522); quality (links to VS-31); merchandising/private label (links to VS-01/VS-41); ESG (links to VS-25.3); graphics (links to VS-14); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Merchandising build the material-transition roadmap: SKU prioritization (high-volume/high-plastic first), target materials (recyclable mono-material, biodegradable, compostable, recycled-content), feasibility, cost/performance trade-off, and timeline to the EPR/sustainability target (links to VS-25.3)

Packaging Eng/Supplier develop and validate substitute packaging: spec (W3522), testing (links to VS-31), shelf-life/performance, graphics (links to VS-14), and supplier qualification; manage pilot and rollout, and last-time-buy of displaced material (links to W1026)

Packaging Eng/FP&A track transition progress (% recyclable/biodegradable, plastic tons reduced, cost delta), validate against the business case, and report to the ESG program (links to VS-25.3) and governance (W3544); manage trade-offs transparently

fields.Participants: Compliance (links to VS-22), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Packaging Eng, Legal (links to VS-100.3), Finance (links to VS-17), Quality (links to VS-31), Audit (links to VS-21)
fields.Trigger: Compliance cycle (links to VS-22); EPR/annual reporting (W3526)

workflows.name: Packaging Compliance Audit & DENR / EPR Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System continuous audit of "audit packaging regulatory compliance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "Sustainability/Compliance manage EPR and DENR reporting" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Audit/Legal validate compliance and reporting for accuracy and record-keeping" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: data discipline and assurance; operational: regulatory monitoring (links to VS-22)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reporting-inaccuracy risk**: Inaccurate EPR/waste data attracts penalty; mitigated by data discipline and assurance
- **Regulatory-miss risk**: New packaging/plastic rules unnoticed; mitigated by regulatory monitoring (links to VS-22.3)
System Touchpoints: - Compliance/permits (links to VS-22/VS-31); hazmat (links to VS-24.3); ESG/EPR (links to VS-25.3); DENR/LGU (links to VS-73.2/VS-76); records (links to VS-88); audit (links to VS-21); legal (links to VS-100.3)

steps.activity: Compliance/Packaging Eng audit packaging regulatory compliance: labeling (W3527), hazmat/UN packaging (links to VS-24.3), DTI-BPS/ICC/FDA (links to VS-22/VS-31), ISPM-15 for wood pallets (links to VS-87), and LGU plastic ordinances (links to VS-76); manage non-compliance and corrective action

Sustainability/Compliance manage EPR and DENR reporting (links to W3526): packaging-data collection (material/weight/type), PRO plan/submission and fees, DENR waste/chemical reporting where applicable (links to VS-73.2), and LGU plastic-rule reports (links to VS-76); ensure accuracy and assurance

Audit/Legal validate compliance and reporting for accuracy and record-keeping (links to VS-88), manage regulator inspections/queries (links to VS-22.2), and report packaging-compliance status to governance (W3544) and the audit committee (links to VS-36/VS-21); track regulatory change (links to VS-22.3)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Quality (links to VS-31), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), DC (links to VS-04), Claims (links to VS-90), Merchandising (links to VS-01), BI (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: Damage/claims data (links to VS-90/VS-31/W3511); monthly analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyze damage attributed to packaging" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate corrective effectiveness, feed learnings to packaging design" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: root-cause discipline; operational: re-spec tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution-ambiguity risk**: Damage mis-attributed to carrier vs packaging; mitigated by root-cause discipline
- **Recurring-damage risk**: Known packaging weakness not fixed; mitigated by re-spec tracking
System Touchpoints: - Damage/claims (links to VS-90/VS-31/W3511); quality (links to VS-31); carrier (links to VS-110/W3512); vendor (links to VS-03/W3525); analytics (links to VS-28.1); packaging spec (links to VS-29/W3523)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/BI analyze damage attributed to packaging: damage rate by SKU/category/lane/carrier/packaging-type, cost of damage, and the packaging failure mode (crush, puncture, moisture, abrasion, seal-failure); correlate with transit-packaging spec (W3523)

Packaging Eng/Quality conduct root-cause on high-damage SKUs/lanes: packaging under-spec, vendor non-compliance (W3525), handling/carrier abuse (links to VS-110/W3512), environmental (humidity), or product fragility; recommend corrective action (re-spec, vendor chargeback, handling change)

Packaging Eng/Claims track damage reduction vs baseline, validate corrective effectiveness, feed learnings to packaging design (W3522/W3523) and vendor compliance (W3525), and report damage cost and reduction to analytics (W3542) and governance (W3544)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), SCM, DC (links to VS-04), FP&A (links to VS-17.4), BI (links to VS-28.1), Merchandising (links to VS-01)
fields.Trigger: Freight cost (links to VS-110/W3516); packaging spec (W3522)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics analyze packaging cube and pallet-build efficiency" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate savings, and report to freight analytics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: cube analytics; operational: joint packaging/logistics analysis
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cube-blindspot risk**: Air-shipment and poor pallet-build waste freight cost; mitigated by cube analytics
- **Sub-optimization risk**: Packaging cube optimized at the expense of protection; mitigated by joint packaging/logistics analysis
System Touchpoints: - Freight/cube (links to VS-110/W3516); DC/WMS (links to VS-04); packaging spec (links to VS-29/W3522); ESG (links to VS-25); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Logistics analyze packaging cube and pallet-build efficiency: case/pallet cube utilization, pallet pattern (units/layer/layers/pallet), trailer/container fill, and air-shipment; identify low-cube SKUs and pallet-build improvements (links to W3523)

Packaging Eng/SCM model and execute cube improvements: right-size packaging (W3522), modular pallet sizes (W3529), pallet-pattern optimization, and load consolidation (links to VS-110/W3507); quantify the freight-cost and CO₂ savings (links to VS-25)

Packaging Eng/FP&A track cube/freight improvement vs baseline (links to VS-110/W3516), validate savings, and report to freight analytics (links to W3516) and governance (W3544); coordinate with freight reduction (links to W3518)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, FP&A (links to VS-17.4), SCM (links to VS-03/VS-34), BI (links to VS-28.1), Finance (links to VS-17), Merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-101)

workflows.name: Total Cost of Packaging & ROI Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track packaging cost-as-%-of-COGS and per-unit over time, and feed…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: total-cost view; operational: rigorous baseline and tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-silo risk**: Material cost optimized while damage/freight/waste cost rise; mitigated by total-cost view
- **ROI-overstatement risk**: Initiative savings overstated; mitigated by rigorous baseline and tracking
System Touchpoints: - Packaging-BOM/cost (links to VS-29/W3528); FP&A (links to VS-17.4); BI (links to VS-28.1); merchandising (links to VS-01/VS-101); PMO (links to VS-112)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/FP&A compute the total cost of packaging (TCP): material (W3528), pallet/RTI (W3529/W3530/W3536), handling, damage (W3540), freight-cube impact (W3541), waste/disposal (W3537), and sustainability premium (W3526); by SKU/category/channel

Packaging Eng/SCM model ROI of packaging initiatives: right-sizing, material transition (W3538), RTI vs single-use (W3529), and automation; compute payback/IRR and prioritize; manage via the PMO (links to VS-112)

Packaging Eng/FP&A publish TCP and initiative ROI to executives (links to VS-33.2) and governance (W3544), track packaging cost-as-%-of-COGS and per-unit over time, and feed merchandising/finance decisions (links to VS-01/VS-101) and reduction (links to W3518)

fields.Participants: Packaging Eng, Store Ops (links to VS-07), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Compliance (links to VS-22/VS-76), Marketing (links to VS-14), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Finance (links to VS-17)
fields.Trigger: LGU plastic ordinances (links to VS-76); sustainability target (links to VS-25)

workflows.name: Single-Use Plastic Reduction & Bag Policy Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "Packaging Eng/Compliance map single-use-plastic exposure and LGU ordinances" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Store Ops/Packaging Eng implement the bag/packaging policy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track plastic reduction" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: region-specific policy and POS config; operational: reusable-bag program and communication
Pain Points / Risks: - **LGU-variation risk**: Inconsistent bag rules across 200 stores; mitigated by region-specific policy and POS config
- **Customer-friction risk**: Bag charges upset customers; mitigated by reusable-bag program and communication
System Touchpoints: - LGU compliance (links to VS-76); POS bag-charge (links to VS-08/VS-80); ESG (links to VS-25.3); customer comms (links to VS-13/VS-14); finance (links to VS-17)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Compliance map single-use-plastic exposure and LGU ordinances: plastic bags, product packaging, secondary packaging, and the varying LGU plastic-bag bans/fees across BuildRight's 200-store footprint (links to VS-76); define the compliant bag/packaging policy by region

Store Ops/Packaging Eng implement the bag/packaging policy: reusable-bag program, bag fees/charges per LGU (links to VS-08 POS), paper/biodegradable alternatives, and customer communication (links to VS-13/VS-14); manage POS bag-charge and the revenue/refund accounting (links to VS-17/VS-80)

Sustainability/Compliance track plastic reduction (bags issued, plastic tons reduced, fee revenue), ensure LGU compliance (links to VS-76), report to the ESG program (links to VS-25.3) and governance (W3544), and manage plastic-bag levy/fee accounting and remittance where applicable

fields.Participants: VP Merchandising, COO, Sustainability/ESG Manager, CFO, Packaging Eng, SCM, Sustainability (links to VS-25), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Innovation (links to VS-30)
fields.Trigger: Annual strategy; board/exec cycle (links to VS-33/VS-36)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Packaging Eng/Innovation drive packaging innovation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "VP Merchandising/SCM conduct the quarterly packaging-program review" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve policy/standard updates" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-564 (ensure controlled execution — Packaging Sustainability, Compliance & Cost Analytics (PA-111.3).)
- operational: innovation and benchmarking; operational: quarterly governance and board oversight
Pain Points / Risks: - **Innovation-stagnation risk**: Packaging fails to evolve with materials/regulation; mitigated by innovation and benchmarking
- **Program-drift risk**: Packaging program drifts from cost/sustainability targets; mitigated by quarterly governance and board oversight
System Touchpoints: - Innovation (links to VS-30); strategy/performance (links to VS-33); ESG (links to VS-25); margin (links to VS-101); board reporting (links to VS-36); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Packaging Eng/Innovation drive packaging innovation: new materials/technologies (active/smart packaging, RFID-embedded links to VS-23, automation-friendly packaging), pilot programs, industry benchmarking, and adoption of best practice; align to innovation strategy (links to VS-30)

VP Merchandising/SCM conduct the quarterly packaging-program review: portfolio performance (cost W3542, damage W3540, sustainability W3526/W3538, compliance W3539), initiative pipeline and ROI, pallet/RTI pool (W3529), and EPR progress; decide adjustments and resource allocation

COO/Sustainability/ESG Manager report the packaging program (cost, sustainability, compliance, innovation) to the executive committee (links to VS-33.2) and Board/sustainability committee (links to VS-36/VS-25); ensure alignment with ESG, margin (links to VS-101), and regulatory strategy and approve policy/standard updates
